source_mapping.graph: Selected package ceditor default features[]; its cagents path dependency disables root defaults and explicitly enables ui. Root library therefore compiles ui production modules, including changed project_search/repository_widget/ui_controls/workspace_widget and optional ignore/memchr dependencies, plus the standalone application caller. It does not select host, full or integrated-browser through this consumer.
source_mapping.needed: The standalone app imports shared RepositoryRuntime/RepositoryAction and UI/public control contracts. Workspace default-members=[.] means the existing root UI5 browserless binary check cannot compile this downstream binary. One separate ceditor check is required.
source_mapping.variants: Only the existing browserless standalone graph is required here. Ceditor declares default[] and development=[cagents/development], with no integrated-browser feature or browser consumer variant. Adding dependency feature cagents/integrated-browser merely to manufacture a standalone integrated variant would broaden the graph without another affected standalone contract. Development changes identity and is not needed for this compiler-consumer floor.

source_mapping.graph: Root default full remains selected; integrated-browser explicitly selects full+ui and Servo/browser dependencies. Its ui graph also includes the changed Search/editor/shared controls. host is absent. src/lib.rs includes the shared src/modules.rs list; its integrated-browser-gated browser module is enabled here.
source_mapping.needed: This separately checks the actual root integrated consumer alongside existing browserless UI5 coverage. The standalone browserless check cannot qualify this Servo/UI combination. Do not combine host+ui, --workspace, --all-features or all binary targets.

Later controller must freeze its actual existing context rather than infer the default wins an override.
existing_serial_C_compatibility.identity: Run Cargo from the exact7be checkout. Its .cargo/config.toml forces CAGENTS_CHECKOUT_ROOT relative to the checkout; src/modules.rs, ceditor main and build.rs track it. Preserve these inputs when sharing targets so owned artifacts follow the selected checkout. No clean/bootstrap or target relocation is authorized.
